synthetic_sequence_limitation: 288-bin sequences are synthetic activity/inactivity sequences, not observed device activity or real screen-inactivity measurements.
prediction_time_mismatch: Training preprocessing derives sequence summaries from full-day simulated sequences, while API inactivity inference masks future bins. Sequence-derived summaries are excluded from primary experiments.
